title: Find your way through larger zone maps
content:
Wiki zone maps

  • A clearer view of large zones. Zone maps arrange connected groups of rooms together and use the available panel space. Fit to View shows the complete zone, including large maps such as Alatorin.
  • Keep track of your room. The selected room has a distinct marker and a name button. Choose Find to center it at a closer zoom, then follow the brighter connections or the room's exit buttons. Arrows show travel direction, and dashed connections identify up/down exits.
  • Maps adapt as you browse. The map resizes with the desktop panels and phone tabs. Fullscreen shows the whole zone and restores your previous view when you leave it. Room-list buttons also support keyboard selection.
